GenerateCartoonizedImage.title: Generative Image Cartoonization
GenerateCartoonizedImage.description:
## Feature Description  
This feature leverages a generative large language model (LLM) to generate images in various cartoon styles. By uploading an input image and selecting a desired cartoon style, you can obtain a cartoonized output image with the same resolution as the original but rendered in the specified style.  

The following diagram illustrates this API's functionality (the left image is the original; the right image is the processed result):  
![](https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231227/rfpk/GenerateCartoonizedImagezonglan.png" width="600)  

Detailed descriptions of each available style are provided below (the left image is the original; the right image is the processed result):  

- **Retro Comic Style**  
  This style emulates comic aesthetics from the 1980s–1990s. It transforms real-world scenes—including people, animals, landscapes, and furniture—into vivid, line-defined comic illustrations with bright colors.  
  ![](https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231227/iyrz/GenerateCartoonizedImagefugu.png" width="600)  

- **3D Fairy Tale Style**  
  This style mimics 3D animated fairy tales. It stylizes real-world scenes—including people, animals, landscapes, and furniture—into soft-toned 3D animations. While preserving most features of the original image, it also introduces new elements to enhance playfulness.  
  ![](https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231227/vmjn/GenerateCartoonizedImage3d.png" width="600)  

- **Anime Style**  
  This style replicates Japanese anime aesthetics. It transforms real-world scenes—including people, animals, landscapes, and furniture—into vibrant anime-style illustrations. Scenic photos, in particular, become highly anime-like. The style preserves most original features while adding new elements for enhanced engagement.  
  ![](https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231227/ffhd/GenerateCartoonizedImage2ciyuan.png" width="600)  

- **Minimalist Fresh Style**  
  Characterized by soft, muted colors, this style primarily focuses on human subjects but also works well with other image types. The resulting images resemble illustrations by GD-style artists, making it ideal for users who prefer hand-drawn illustration aesthetics.  
  ![](https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231227/ubyx/GenerateCartoonizedImagexiaoqingxin.png" width="600)  

- **Futuristic Sci-Fi Style**  
  This style simulates futuristic mecha sci-fi aesthetics. It introduces dramatic visual transformations, offering high playability—ideal for users interested in futuristic technology themes.  
  ![](https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231227/bxvf/GenerateCartoonizedImageweilaikeji.png" width="600)  

- **Traditional Chinese Ink Painting Style**  
  This style emulates classical Chinese gongbi (meticulous brushwork) painting. It dresses human subjects in traditional attire to create realistic classical Chinese artworks, appealing to fans of guochao (Chinese cultural trend) aesthetics.  
  ![](https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231227/jtkr/GenerateCartoonizedImageguohuagufeng.png" width="600)  

- **Ancient General Style**  
  This style simulates ancient battlefield aesthetics, combining human figures with armor elements to evoke a strong classical atmosphere.  
  ![](https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231227/abqy/GenerateCartoonizedImagejiangjunbaizhan.png" width="600)  

- **Colorful Hand-Drawn Style**  
  This style mimics hand-painted watercolor and crayon techniques, delivering a distinct handmade, hand-drawn feel.  
  ![](https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231227/yrjf/GenerateCartoonizedImagexuancaikatong.png" width="600)  

- **Elegant Traditional Chinese Style**  
  This style emulates refined classical Chinese aesthetics. It dresses human subjects in traditional attire with a 2.5D visual effect, making it highly suitable for users who appreciate traditional Chinese art.  
  ![](https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231227/tztf/GenerateCartoonizedImageqingyaguofeng.png" width="600)  

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- A full free trial of this capability is available on the Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?tagName=imageenhan&children=GenerateCartoonizedImage) for an intuitive hands-on experience or to purchase online.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Alibaba Cloud’s Visual Intelligence API, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us directly.  

## Common Scenarios  
**Social Media Profile Picture Generation**: Users can upload selfies, pet photos, or landscape images and select a preferred cartoon style to generate personalized avatars with high playability.  

## Key Advantages  
- **Broad Applicability**: Powered by a generative LLM, it processes diverse elements—including portraits, pets, and scenes—to produce detailed and vivid cartoon effects.  
- **Diverse Styles**: Supports multiple generation styles to meet varied user preferences and requirements.  
- **Intelligent Processing**: Automatically detects attributes such as subject gender and scene category to ensure outputs are both visually appealing and faithful to the original image.  
- **High Quality**: Generates high-fidelity images with minimal artifacts.  

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner, click **Sign Up** and follow the instructions to complete registration.  
2. **Activate the service**: Ensure you have activated the [Image Enhancement Service](https://vision.aliyun.com/imageenhan). If not, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_imageenhan_public_cn#/open).  
3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, grant the RAM user the `AliyunVIAPIFullAccess` permission. For details, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: Use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/imageenhan/2019-09-30/GenerateImageWithText?lang=JAVA) to debug the API online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. **Development integration**:  
   - Select your preferred programming language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the AI category "imageenhan" (Image Enhancement).  
   - Modify and invoke the API using the sample code provided in the documentation.  

6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used languages, see [Generative Image Cartoonization Sample Code](~~602271~~). For examples on querying asynchronous task results, see [Query Asynchronous Task Result Sample Code](~~607974~~).  

7. **Direct client invocation**: Common client-side invocation methods include:  
   - [Direct invocation from web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)  

## Input Constraints  

- Image size must not exceed 10 MB.  
- Supported image formats: JPEG, PNG, JPG, BMP, WEBP.  
- Input image dimensions must be at least 256×256 pixels and at most 5760×3240 pixels.  
- The output image’s shorter edge is fixed at 1536 pixels. If the ratio of the longer edge to the shorter edge of the input image is ≤ 1.5:1, the original aspect ratio is preserved. If the ratio exceeds 1.5:1, automatic rotation (adaptive cropping) is applied to adjust the output aspect ratio to 1.5:1.  

## Invocation Steps  
This is an asynchronous API and requires two steps:  
1. Call the `GenerateCartoonizedImage` API to submit a job. Upon successful request, you receive a job ID.  
2. Call the [`GetAsyncJobResult`](~~607824~~) API to query the result using the job ID. If the job is still processing, wait briefly before querying again.

## Feature Description  
The image invisible text watermark feature can add or parse specified text watermarks in images.

## Common Scenarios  
- **Copyright protection**: Authors legally hold copyright over their images. Adding an invisible watermark helps prove ownership for the author or authorized party, preventing unauthorized use of the image.  
- **Preventing information leakage**: Different invisible watermarks can be embedded for different viewers of confidential images. If an image is leaked, the source of the leak can be identified by parsing the invisible watermark.

## Key Advantages  
Compared with traditional visible stamp watermarks, invisible watermarks are imperceptible to viewers and do not affect image quality. ## Feature Description  
The RecolorImage feature automatically transforms the colors of an input image or recolors it according to a specified color palette, while avoiding abnormal color spreading in visually prominent (hot spot) areas.  

An example illustration of this API's functionality is shown below:  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221108/zlbh/RecolorImage.png)

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for visual AI capabilities of the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform, please join our consultation DingTalk group (23109592) by searching for the group number.

## Mode Description  

- **Automatic Recoloring**  
Specify the number of recolored results (i.e., the number of extended color schemes). The algorithm computes a uniform sampling method in the color space to generate recolored images matching the requested quantity. In simple terms, if you request N color schemes, the system outputs N images.  
For example, Figure 1 below shows the original image; Figure 2 shows the result with the color scheme count set to 3; and Figure 3 shows the result with the count set to 6.  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221108/yrni/RecolorImagezidong.png" width="600)

- **Palette-Based Recoloring**  
Provide a list of colors (a color palette). The algorithm uses these colors as the primary hues to recolor the original image, offering stronger control over the resulting colors. The length of the color list must not exceed the specified limit.  
For example, if you input `[#0000FF, #00FF00, #FF0000]`, corresponding to `[pure blue, pure green, pure red]`, the recolored result appears as follows:  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221108/ksyc/RecolorImageseban.png" width="300)

- **Reference Image Recoloring**  
You provide a reference image, and the algorithm recolors the original image based on the colors in the reference image.  
For example, given the following reference image:  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221108/zauu/RecolorImagecankaotu.png" width="300)  
the recolored result is:  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221108/qxgz/RecolorImagejieguo.png" width="300)

- **Image formats**: JPEG, JPG, PNG, BMP.  
- **Image size**: No larger than 3 MB.  
- **Image resolution**: Greater than 64×64 pixels and less than 1200×1200 pixels.  
- **Color channels**: Must be either RGB (3-channel) or RGBA (4-channel).  
- **Color content**: Avoid images that are predominantly black, white, or grayscale.
